meta.stageLabel: Earth — just after Release the HypnoDrones (cheats)
meta.speedControl: none (real time; cheats pre-fill resources per stage)
jumpNotes: cheatClips() x1  (+100M clips/unusedClips → compFlag+projectsFlag; trust ramps to ~24 via calculateTrust)
cheatMoney() x10, cheatTrust() x70, cheatCreat() x50, cheatYomi() x1, cheatOps() x50
addProc()/addMem() via game functions → processors 25, memory 69 (trust 94)

stage-1 projects: clicked 30 projects in order: RevTracker | Algorithmic Trading | Creativity | Limerick | Lexical Processing | Combinatory Harmonics | The Hadwiger Problem | The Tóth Sausage Conjecture | Donkey Space | Coherent Extrapolated Volition | Quantum Computing | New Slogan | Catchy Jingle | Hadwiger Clip Diagrams | Strategic Modeling | Cure for Cancer | World Peace | Male Pattern Baldness | Global Warming | Hypno Harmonics | New Strategy: A100 | AutoTourney | HypnoDrones | New Strategy: B100 | New Strategy: GREEDY | New Strategy: GENEROUS | New Strategy: MINIMAX | New Strategy: TIT FOR TAT | New Strategy: BEAT LAST | Theory of Mind  (memory raised with cheatTrust()+addMem() whenever a visible project cost more ops than memory*1000; ops refilled with cheatOps(); creativity with cheatCreat(); funds with cheatMoney(); yomi with cheatYomi(); now processors 25, memory 70, trust 157)
addMem()/addProc() alternately with the remaining trust → processors 56, memory 101, trust 157
direct writes: tempOps=0; standardOps=memory*1000 (ops at cap); creativity=10000; yomi=50000
